name: Blur Rise Text
description: A GSAP text animation for React: characters rise out of a heavy blur and sharpen into place, staggered from the edges inward on a long expo ease. Plays once when it scrolls into view, or right away when it's already on screen (a hero or header). SplitText + ScrollTrigger.

props.name: children
props.description: The text. Works for a single word or a full heading; words never break mid-word.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds each character takes to settle.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Seconds spread across all characters (in total, not per character).

props.name: distance
props.description: How far below each character starts, in em.

props.name: trigger
props.description: 'view' plays once when the text reaches start, or immediately if it's already on screen at load; 'mount' plays as soon as it renders.

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element, when it isn't the window.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the text (font, size, colour).
